#### Game support requests

Requests for new games must include the following

- Detailed instructions on how the game is modded. For example, where files go, how archives are unpacked/routed or any caveats I should be aware of.
- Does the game normally require a specialised mod manager or is manual modding possible
- Does the game have any external applications that need to be run for modding to be functional and do they work via proton or have linux native alternatives
- If any documentation exists on modding the game please provide it

I will usually look into each game requested but the above information is to make my life easier. Remember that I don't own every game ever made or know how they all work so researching and testing an implementation can take time. Not providing any information makes it more likely that I reject the request

**Note that if a game is seemingly too complex to add and I have no way of testing any implementation, I will not add it**
